changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: Repair duplicate ACTIVE facts before installing partial unique indexes.
changeSet.sql:
-- Same exact ACTIVE fact more than once: keep the most recently confirmed row. WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY customer_id, fact_type, fact_key, normalized_value ORDER BY last_confirmed_at DESC NULLS LAST, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ) AS rn FROM customer_memory_fact WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) UPDATE customer_memory_fact f SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' FROM ranked r WHERE f.id = r.id AND r.rn > 1;
-- SINGLE-valued facts must have only one ACTIVE value for a key. WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY customer_id, fact_type, fact_key ORDER BY last_confirmed_at DESC NULLS LAST, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ) AS rn FROM customer_memory_fact WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND cardinality = 'SINGLE' ) UPDATE customer_memory_fact f SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' FROM ranked r WHERE f.id = r.id AND r.rn > 1;

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: Merge duplicate PENDING candidates and collapse duplicate evidence per candidate/chat.

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: Collapse duplicate durable episodes to one row per chat/segment and repair soft evidence references.
changeSet.sql:
-- Keep the newest episode for a duplicated chat/segment. WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, first_value(id) OVER ( PARTITION BY chat_id, segment_number ORDER BY id DESC ) AS keep_id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY chat_id, segment_number ORDER BY id DESC ) AS rn FROM customer_memory_episode ) UPDATE customer_memory_candidate_evidence e SET episode_id = r.keep_id FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn > 1 AND e.episode_id = r.id;
WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY chat_id, segment_number ORDER BY id DESC ) AS rn FROM customer_memory_episode ) DELETE FROM customer_memory_episode e USING ranked r WHERE e.id = r.id AND r.rn > 1;

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: Preserve legacy duplicate processing jobs while making their idempotency keys distinct.
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT j.id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY j.idempotency_key ORDER BY CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer_memory_chat_state s WHERE s.active_job_id = j.id ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, j.id DESC ) AS rn FROM customer_memory_processing_job j ) UPDATE customer_memory_processing_job j SET idempotency_key = left(j.idempotency_key, 250) || ':legacy-duplicate:' || j.id FROM ranked r WHERE j.id = r.id AND r.rn > 1;

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: At most one ACTIVE row for the same normalized fact value.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uq_cm_fact_active_value ON customer_memory_fact (customer_id, fact_type, fact_key, normalized_value) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: SINGLE-valued fact definitions may have only one ACTIVE value per customer/type/key.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uq_cm_fact_active_single_key ON customer_memory_fact (customer_id, fact_type, fact_key) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND cardinality = 'SINGLE';

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: Only one live PENDING candidate may accumulate evidence for the same normalized value.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uq_cm_candidate_pending_value ON customer_memory_candidate (customer_id, fact_type, fact_key, normalized_value) WHERE status = 'PENDING';

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: A candidate can have at most one evidence row from a given chat; repeated mentions refresh it.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uq_cm_candidate_evidence_chat ON customer_memory_candidate_evidence (candidate_id, chat_id);

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.comment: Each chat segment has exactly one durable L2 episode.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uq_cm_episode_chat_segment ON customer_memory_episode (chat_id, segment_number);

changeSet.author: jahongir.zokirov
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uq_cm_proc_job_idempotency_key ON customer_memory_processing_job (idempotency_key);
